Mimo for Android 1.0.5

English

New features
- Choose nodes before connecting: while stopped, the Proxies page loads proxy sets and shows each group's saved choice. A node picked there is restored before the VPN carries any traffic, so the first connection already uses it.
- YAML editor syntax features and editing tools: whitespace display, go to line, advanced find and replace with regular expressions, line actions and a YAML symbol bar.
- Automatic app update checks under More → About & privacy. A new version is only announced; nothing is downloaded or installed without you.

Major fixes
- Global mode no longer sends traffic direct by default: while GLOBAL is still on DIRECT, it follows the policy of the profile's MATCH rule, applied before the VPN starts.
- The Home connection card now shows the node behind the profile's MATCH rule, matching the actual exit, instead of following whichever group was picked last. Path latency tests the same node.

Performance
- Proxy sets loaded while stopped are kept in the profile's private directory and reused when connecting.

Experience improvements
- A prominent Start VPN action on Home; when connected, the connection card takes the accent color and the action becomes a compact power button. Without a profile, Home guides you to add one.
- One collapsing title bar on every main page, segmented lists in Tools, More and Profiles, and card view switches in header menus.
- Latency is colored by speed; group and all-node tests show each node's progress and the overall progress.
- Native bottom sheets with platform motion, clearer toggles and a wavy subscription quota indicator.

Other fixes
- Fixed expanded subscription sheets, dashboard card dragging and clipped status text while connecting.

Core
- Bundled mihomo v1.19.34. Requires Android 8.0 or newer and an arm64 device.

简体中文

新增功能
- 连接前即可选择节点：未连接时，代理页会加载代理集，并显示各组已保存的选择。在这里选好的节点会在 VPN 接管流量前恢复，第一次连接就走所选节点。
- YAML 编辑器新增语法功能和编辑工具：显示空白字符、跳转行号、支持正则的高级查找替换、行操作和 YAML 符号栏。
- 「更多 → 关于与隐私」新增自动检查应用更新。发现新版只提示，不会自动下载或安装。

重大修复
- 全局模式不再默认直连：GLOBAL 仍停在 DIRECT 时，改用配置中 MATCH 规则的策略，并在 VPN 启动前完成。
- 首页连接卡改为显示配置 MATCH 规则所指策略的节点，与实际出口一致，不再随最后操作的策略组变化；路径延迟也测同一节点。

性能优化
- 未连接时加载的代理集保存在该配置的私有目录，连接时直接复用。

体验改进
- 首页新增醒目的「启动 VPN」按钮；连接后连接卡改用主题色，按钮收为边缘的电源小按钮。没有配置时，首页会引导添加。
- 各主页面使用统一的可折叠标题栏，工具、更多和配置列表改为分段样式，卡片的视图切换移至标题右侧菜单。
- 延迟按快慢着色；整组测速和全部测速会显示每个节点的进度及整体进度。
- 改用系统原生底部面板和动效，开关对比度更清晰，订阅用量改为波浪进度条。

常规修复
- 修复订阅面板展开、首页卡片拖动，以及连接过程中状态文字被截断的问题。

内核更新
- 内置 mihomo v1.19.34，支持 Android 8.0 及以上的 arm64 设备。
